recovered_confirmed_breakdown.price_coordinate: CY-006 accepted causal cumulative log-return coordinate; raw event-day OHLC is mapped by that day's causal close-coordinate scale
recovered_confirmed_breakdown.support_level: minimum causal-coordinate low of the previous 20 completed, consecutive, hard-valid sessions for the same security
recovered_confirmed_breakdown.breakdown_condition: event-date causal-coordinate close strictly below the frozen prior-L20 support
recovered_confirmed_breakdown.confirmation: the completed event-session close; no low-only, intraday-close, reclaim, penetration, or threshold condition
recovered_confirmed_breakdown.signal_known_at: event session 15:00 close; accepted decision timestamp 15:30 Asia/Shanghai
recovered_confirmed_breakdown.gaps: a gap below support is not confirmed until the event-session close remains strictly below support
recovered_confirmed_breakdown.support_updates: recomputed independently each session from that session's previous 20 completed sessions; never frozen at champion entry and never uses the event or future session
recovered_confirmed_breakdown.domain: event date and all previous 20 sessions must be consecutive and history-valid; current event row must be current-valid; unresolved lineage or corporate action fails closed
recovered_confirmed_breakdown.prior_evidence: DOWNSIDE_PREDICTOR: 4,079 complete observations/260 dates, h5 excess -0.344%, early 2018-2020 -0.711%, late 2021-2023 -0.127%
recovered_confirmed_breakdown.minute_semantic_reconciliation: the exact prior signal uses the completed daily close, not a minute crossing; therefore an event-day intraday fill would change the signal and is prohibited

frozen_champion.name: Industry Diffusion + Weekly Low-MAX
frozen_champion.entry_selection: exact frozen champion plans and signal ranks
frozen_champion.weights: existing equal allocation inside each overlapping cohort
frozen_champion.normal_exit: existing due-open exit after 20 sessions, including QD-010 pre-effective exits and legal-fill delays

event_and_execution.event_scan: each completed holding-date close from acquisition day through the last date whose subsequent legal exit could precede the frozen exit
event_and_execution.action: sell every settled active lot in the affected symbol at the first legal open after the close-confirmed signal; preserve cohort attribution
event_and_execution.earliest_fill: next session open because the exact signal is known after the event-session close
event_and_execution.t_plus_one: lots acquired before the fill date are sellable; lots acquired on the fill date are locked
event_and_execution.ordering: process exits before the frozen day's new entries, matching the accepted champion lifecycle; a later legitimate frozen entry is not bespoke re-entry
event_and_execution.locked_lot_rule: if any lot is legally locked at the attempted fill, retain the original breakdown instruction and sell at its first later legal open without recovery/reclaim invalidation
event_and_execution.unexecutable_rule: delay through suspension/limit/no-valid-fill states to the first accepted sellable open; if the frozen lifecycle exits first or simultaneously, record no incremental exit
event_and_execution.higher_cost_stress: 40 bps per side only if the 20-bps replay is authorized and materially improves the primary economics

phase_b_diagnosis.anchor: first legal next-open exit opportunity after confirmation
phase_b_diagnosis.remaining_payoff: original frozen lifecycle proceeds divided by hypothetical confirmed-breakdown exit proceeds minus one
phase_b_diagnosis.maximum_adverse_excursion: minimum accepted causal value after the anchor through frozen exit relative to the anchor value

failure_modes.loser_continuation: position net P&L at breakdown-exit anchor <= 0

phase_b_diagnosis.control: one deterministic champion lot without a prior breakdown by the same date, matched first on event date and exact holding age, then industry, entry cohort, absolute signal-rank distance, and trade_id; relax industry then cohort only when necessary; never use future payoff in matching

phase_c_replay.reentry: only a later independent frozen champion cohort selection; no reclaim, cooldown, or bespoke re-entry

prohibited: support-window, threshold, price-coordinate, confirmation, or signal-time changes
minute low, minute close, intraday crossing, reclaim, penetration-depth, or support-density substitution
champion entry, weekly clock, Top-N, Low-MAX, Industry Diffusion, weighting, or normal lifecycle changes
alternative exit role, stop grid, re-entry rule, recovery rule, cost grid, or rescue replay
market regime or known losing-year conditioning
OOS, independent-confirmation, validation, live, or production claims
